Section 5 ends the Commission at the earlier of two events: 30 days after its final report, or "but not later than 2 years from the date of" the order, September 5, 1996, that is September 5, 1998, "unless extended by the President". The report-relative trigger is not dated by any held source and, under the owner ruling of 2026-10-21 on report deadlines, is a spent report provision and not an end; the fixed outer date is the end. It is recorded as the stated date, inclusive (the Commission runs through the end of September 5, 1998); the exclusive reading (ends when that day begins) is the alternative a reviewer should see. Disclosed limits: if the report-relative trigger fired earlier the Commission would have ended earlier (the date is not held); no extension by the President is held (a search of the held corpus for the number 13017 found only Executive Orders 13040, 13056 and 13138 and the order's own texts; the two amending orders change membership and report dates, not the term). Later event, after the end: Executive Order 13138 section 3(a), effective September 30, 1999, revokes the order as amended (a clean-up of an order that had already ended). research_rationale:
Identity: the registered original is the Federal Register text of Executive Order 13017 (61 FR 47659, PDF pages 1-2 of the 1996-09-09 issue; sha256 7b1e61e7...), headed Executive Order 13017 of September 5, 1996, Advisory Commission on Consumer Protection and Quality in the Health Care Industry, matching the census register row (1996-09-05). Text and inventory: twelve scopes cover sections 1 through 5 to the signature, with the three items of section 2(a) as separate scopes; I confirm the inventory. All clauses belong to one advisory commission. Ending: its own term; section 5 ends it no later than two years from the order, September 5, 1998, unless extended, and no extension is held; Executive Order 13138 section 3(a), effective September 30, 1999, later revokes it. Original grade: Federal Register machine text.
Member checks: {"earlier_end_check":"Candidate earlier ends examined. (1) The report-relative trigger in section 5 (30 days after the final report, due by March 30, 1998 after Executive Order 13040) cannot be dated from held sources, so no earlier own-terms end is claimed; this is a disclosed gap, not a finding that it did not fire. (2) No held instrument extends the Commission past September 5, 1998, and the OFR disposition-note machine search lists three hits (13040, 13056, 13138). (3) The report deadlines in sections 3 are deadlines, not ends.","independent_command_check":"The order has no command that outlives the Commission: the information, compensation, support and Federal Advisory Committee Act provisions serve only the Commission.","savings_check":"Executive Order 13138 has no wording preserving the Commission or its work; sections 1 through 9 were read, and the Commission's end is its own term.","scope_check":"All twelve clauses end together with the Commission on its own terms; Executive Order 13138 section 3(a) later revokes the order as a whole."}

savings.reason: Executive Order 13138 contains no wording that preserves the order establishing the Advisory Commission on Consumer Protection and Quality in the Health Care Industry: its continuance sections concern other committees and its revocation section revokes this order without exception. Reports or other work already done are completed acts; nothing continues the body.
